deliverables.title: Local inference on LIBR compute, and the fleet it is becoming

threads.title: The everyday server (ollama, user-local)
threads.question: Serves the coding models on one A40 from a user-local install. No admin rights anywhere in it. Serving is done; what is left on it is the walltime note in the plan's housekeeping section.

tasks.text: Walltime: both sbatch files default to 8 h. Decide whether a longer-lived server is wanted on c3; ollama-up takes an hours argument for shorter ones

threads.title: Up, code, down (bin/ollama-*)
threads.question: Three scripts that submit the job, wait until it is really serving, and open an agent on its node.

threads.title: The coding agent (opencode, and its fence)
threads.question: opencode on the serving node, with web access denied globally and raised for one agent only.

tasks.text: Raise coder's webfetch from ask to allow, leave websearch at ask and the top-level deny alone; opencode agent list must show every other agent still at deny

decisions.q: Web access for the coding agent
decisions.rule: coder gets webfetch allow and websearch ask. The global default-deny stays, so the built-in explore subagent stays closed.

threads.title: The consultant (colibri, GLM-5.2 int4)
threads.question: 744B on most of a 1 TB node, one user at a time, for work that cannot leave the building. Serving is done.

decisions.q: How many KV slots colibri serves
Whether MTP is forced off; one A/B on a warm server settles it

threads.title: The five colibri commands (bin/coli*)
threads.question: Build, submit, ask, code and cancel. Each finds the job through squeue and steps onto its node. coli-ask is the interactive one and coli-code is the overnight one: the preamble is the bill.

threads.title: The engine (vendor/colibri-build/c)
threads.question: The int4 GLM kernel, built at a pinned commit. ARCH=native is what selects the fast path. It lives outside this repository, in the Atlas checkout, and is not in git. Rebuild after a clone.

threads.title: Keeping upstream current (a daily user timer)
threads.question: board/scripts/tutor-pull fast-forwards the vendor/colibri submodule once a day from a systemd user timer. Never build in it; the timer expects a clean tree. README section 2.1 is the whole of it.

threads.title: The measurement campaign (P0)
threads.question: Twelve tests that decide the fleet's shape. Ten have passed and fifteen findings contradict the runbook.

threads.title: The fleet
threads.question: Three engines behind one front door, taking GPUs when free and yielding them when somebody else is blocked. Designed in full in DESIGN.md and scheduled in FLEET-BUILD.md. None of it is built.

tasks.text: Build the vllm path for PSYCH-ASR Stage 3c, fleet milestone M0/M1: scrub SLURM_* before any srun or sbatch, and expect a multi-minute cold load

threads.title: Where PHI goes, end to end
threads.question: From a recording under phi/ to a model's answer and back: which process can read it, where every transcript lands, and what stops any of it leaving the building?

tasks.text: Learn: the PHI fence, and why coli-code's session root ends in a directory named phi
Learn: the three layers of the PHI boundary, and why the clinical model never runs through opencode
Learn: what names_phi checks before a push or a save, and what only a hosted turn's judgement can catch

decisions.rule: The clinical model runs from a plain client with no tool-calling surface, so no setting can put transcript text into a search query.

threads.title: The LIBR hardware it runs on
threads.question: Which nodes, GPUs and partitions serve these models, what they measure at, and what the cluster's rules let a user-local service do.

tasks.text: Learn: the cluster's partitions and nodes, the A40s, the 1 TB node, and why NVLink being inactive favours replicas over shards
Learn: the measured rates, 51 tok/s per user on one A40 for the 30B helper against 3.2-4.4 tok/s for the 744B model

threads.title: The deck
threads.question: A deck the owner can defend slide by slide: where PHI goes, the hardware it stays on, and what has been measured.

tasks.text: Build the deck once the owner has had the learn sittings on the PHI path and the hardware
